==============================================
for-of over an automatic semicolon
==============================================

for (let j
    of k)

---

(source_file
  (for_of
    (identifier)
    (identifier)))

==============================================
for-of on one line
==============================================

for (let j    of k)

---

(source_file
  (for_of
    (identifier)
    (identifier)))

==============================================
declaration ended by an automatic semicolon
==============================================

for (let j
    k)

---

(source_file
  (for_declaration
    (declaration
      (declarator
        (identifier)))
    (identifier)))

==============================================
declaration ended by an empty semicolon
==============================================

for (let j    k)

---

(source_file
  (for_declaration
    (declaration
      (declarator
        (identifier)))
    (identifier)))

==============================================
for-of over an automatic semicolon before a tab
==============================================

for (let j
	of k)

---

(source_file
  (for_of
    (identifier)
    (identifier)))

==============================================
declaration ended by two zero-width tokens
==============================================

for (let j
	k)

---

(source_file
  (for_declaration
    (declaration
      (declarator
        (identifier)))
    (identifier)))
